visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses in a bright indoor kitchen holds a frying pan, stirring a thick, bright green spinach paste with a wooden spatula. He looks directly into the camera, explaining the texture. The background features a white kettle and clean tiles under bright lighting. (2) Transition to an IKEA store where the man walks through the aisles, wearing a beige t-shirt and glasses. A young girl in a pink shirt and striped pants follows him. They examine storage furniture and various frames amidst the bustling retail store environment. (3) The man displays various frozen food items like smoked salmon and spinach packages from IKEA. He examines the labels closely. The background shows the food section with refrigerators and other customers walking by in the distance. (4) The scene shifts to the young girl eating a vanilla soft-serve ice cream cone. The man leans in and takes a large bite, his facial expression turning into one of extreme surprise at the sweetness of the dessert. (5) Back in the kitchen, the man pours frozen spinach cubes into a pan and heats them until they melt. He then assembles a large salad in a bowl, adding lettuce, smoked salmon, and a creamy yellow sauce he mixes manually. (6) The man sits at a wooden table and tastes the spinach puree first, making a skeptical face. He then tries the large bowl of smoked salmon salad, showing a very positive and satisfied expression, nodding while chewing. (7) The man speaks directly to the camera, concluding his vlog about his day and the weight-loss meal. The video ends with a simple animation of two characters standing against a plain yellow background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents day 60 of a 100-day weight loss challenge. The creator visits IKEA to buy storage and healthy food options, then returns home to prepare and review a smoked salmon and spinach salad, sharing his experience and results with his audience.
